line: A park that is only a pen sketch; wherever the wind carries her straw hat, colour follows.
line_cn: 公园只是一张钢笔速写，风把草帽吹到哪里，哪里才有颜色。

motion.cuts: slow drift, push-through with a focus pull

camera.serves: a face; a sign; a small event
an object carried; a walker; a vehicle

camera.expresses: a new level, a view opening
camera.serves: a skyline; a tree; a balcony
a fall; a gust; a surprise
a catch; a collision; a door slam

camera.move: Pull back to the whole page
camera.expresses: scale; the sketch as an object
camera.serves: a summary; a place in full

camera.move: Slow pan across a line-only area
Page turn to a new spread
camera.serves: a travel diary; a sequence of days

transitions: Transitions: camera travel on the page, page turns, or colour arriving;
labels: All text is handwriting on the page, written on left to right with pen sound, and moves with the camera: a corner note (e.g. Reenie Beanie: day, time, weather, place), titles and colophon in a casual hand (e.g. Caveat 500–600), left-aligned in the blank margin.
Subtitles, if there is a voice: handwritten lines in the page margin or a caption strip written into the lower margin, never a generic overlay box. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
The style works well without any voice.
motion: Figures boil at 12 fps (line wobble and wash seeds change every 1/12 s). The static page does not boil (it is a real page); the camera moves every frame, smoothly.
Performance: anticipation, action, follow-through; footsteps on the beat.
Invisible forces are drawn: wind as ink curls that draw on and erase from the tail, trailing dabs; sound as ink lines; heat as wavy strokes.
Colour never snaps: it blooms from a point or arrives through the field.

native_moves.name: Line before colour
native_moves.does: The pen draws a subject in real stroke order, then the wash drops in; the drawing is the spectacle.
native_moves.fits: a cathedral façade; a chef plating a dish; a street musician.

native_moves.name: Colour as arrival
native_moves.does: Wash spreads from a source with a wet front, so an event paints the page; figures stay frozen line drawings until colour touches them.
native_moves.fits: a sunrise over a harbour; a parade moving down a street; the lights of a market switching on.

native_moves.name: The one coloured thing
native_moves.does: A colourless sketch with a single tinted object that becomes the protagonist.
native_moves.fits: a red umbrella in the rain; a yellow taxi; a child's kite.

native_moves.name: The page as frame
native_moves.does: Pull back until the whole page shows, edges dissolving, handwritten notes in the margin.
native_moves.fits: a travel diary entry; a neighbourhood portrait; a day in a place.

native_moves.name: Carrot people
native_moves.does: Distant crowds as one wash blob, two leg lines and a head dot.
native_moves.fits: a station at rush hour; a stadium; a beach.
